name: str2double
expr: r1 = str2double("3.14"); r2 = str2double("42"); r3 = str2double("-1.5"); c1 = str2double("1,234"); c2 = str2double("1,2,3"); c3 = str2double("1,000,000"); n1 = double(isnan(str2double("42abc"))); n2 = double(isnan(str2double("42 7"))); n3 = double(isnan(str2double(",")));
comment: Sig: r = str2double(...). MATLAB strips ALL commas (thousands separators) and requires the ENTIRE trimmed token to parse: str2double('1,234')=1234, '1,2,3'=123, '1,000,000'=1e6; '42abc'/'42 7'/',' -> NaN. numkit previously used std::stod (lenient prefix parse: '1,234'->1, '42abc'->42); fixed 2026-05-29. (Complex literals like '2i'/'3+4i' remain a separate unimplemented gap.) Spec-extension batch 2026-05-09.
